description: This file is a shell script for testing Git diff context options and configurations. It sets up test cases to verify how the diff context setting affects Git commands like diff, log, and diff-files, including handling of edge cases like invalid or negative values.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, executes the provided shell commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that the preceding command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_grep

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Counts lines in a file or output.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets or queries Git configuration settings, particularly diff.context.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
